heroDesc: 30 minutes to unpack the product, workflow, offer, or funnel you want to improve—and identify the clearest next move.

expectations.title: You talk, I listen
expectations.body: Tell me what you want to build, what already exists, and where the project or business is getting stuck.

expectations.title: We find the real scope
expectations.body: We'll separate the useful first version from the nice-to-haves and connect the build to the business outcome.

expectations.title: You leave with clarity
expectations.body: Whether we work together or not, you'll leave with a clearer product, system, or funnel direction.
